title: Design and Architecture
intro: Product, app, brand, fashion design and architecture. Design courses are open to all streams.

nodes.label: Private design colleges
nodes.note: Many private colleges have their own tests and portfolio rounds. Check each college.

nodes.label: B.Des (4 years)
nodes.note: Product, communication, interaction, fashion and animation design.

nodes.label: B.FTech (fashion technology)
nodes.note: 4 years. Maths is needed in Class 12.

nodes.label: B.Arch (5 years)
nodes.note: Needs Physics and Maths in Class 12. Register with the Council of Architecture after.

nodes.label: UX and app designer
nodes.note: Design how apps and websites feel to use.

nodes.label: Product designer
nodes.note: Design things people use, from chairs to gadgets.

nodes.label: Graphic and brand designer
nodes.note: Logos, posters, packaging and brands.

nodes.label: Fashion designer
nodes.note: Design clothes, textiles and accessories.

nodes.label: Animator or game designer
nodes.note: Make characters, films and games.

nodes.label: Architect
nodes.note: Design buildings and spaces.

nodes.label: Motion graphics designer
nodes.note: Make moving titles and effects.

nodes.label: Game artist
nodes.note: Create characters and worlds for games.

nodes.label: Industrial designer
nodes.note: Shape everyday products.

nodes.label: Art director
nodes.note: Lead the look of ads, films and magazines.

nodes.label: Packaging designer
nodes.note: Design boxes and labels.

nodes.label: Interior designer
nodes.note: Design homes and offices inside.

nodes.label: Photographer
nodes.note: Take pictures for people and brands.

nodes.label: Jewellery designer
nodes.note: Design rings, necklaces and more.

nodes.label: Textile designer
nodes.note: Design fabrics and prints.

nodes.label: UX researcher

nodes.label: Fashion stylist
